data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Megha' meaning cloud, mist, rain. Parents who choose Meghu usually hope their child will grow to embody cloud, mist, rain and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Meghu is a common name for women in ancient India, meaning 'cloud' in Sanskrit. Meghu is a name mentioned in the Mahabharata epic, where she is the daughter of the sage Bhagiratha and the wife of King Rishyasringa.

Meghu is also the name of a goddess in Hindu mythology, represented as the wife of Lord Indra, the god of rain. She is often depicted as a beautiful woman riding on a white elephant and carrying an umbrella, symbolizing her role in providing shade during the monsoon rains.
